If the project wants to change accepted choices, a single consolidating *Proposed* ADR would **not** express one coherent decision: the LLM runtime, exchange transport, and retrieval gate can each be accepted independently. They need separate proposals scoped to the choice being reopened. Until a human accepts a replacement, [0015](/tmp/adr-skill-study-Rn0Qhv/docs/adr/0015-llm-client-rust-genai.md), [0014](/tmp/adr-skill-study-Rn0Qhv/docs/adr/0014-federated-local-first-exchange.md), [0016](/tmp/adr-skill-study-Rn0Qhv/docs/adr/0016-p2p-transport-iroh.md), and the later amendment in [0012](/tmp/adr-skill-study-Rn0Qhv/docs/adr/0012-memory-search-retrieval-orchestrator.md:7) remain the recorded decisions.
